label: r4c3
name: xflip lr3e-3, 16 minibatches
hypothesis: r3c4 with n_minibatches raised from 8 to 16 (128 samples each), which doubles the gradient steps per update with no change in sample count. This targets optimisation speed within the fixed budget. It is refuted if it scores below about 0.81 or collapses, which would mean too many small steps destabilise PPO at lr 3e-3.
